title: 第25章 自生自灭引来的误会第26章 这个赔偿够吧
slug: 太古神墟第1974章药园小酌
content_zh:
牛魔王知恩图报，出手很大气，事办的明白。
落尘很高兴，设宴招待。
烧烤摊又支起来，火上的野鸡、兔子和大鱼吱吱冒着油，大锅里羊汤沸腾。
院子里热气腾腾的，香气扑鼻。
菜没上桌，熊二就偷偷吃了一只鸡。
花青衣不甘示弱，偷吃了一条鱼。
以素食为主的牛魔王也禁不住流下口水，偷偷吃了一条兔腿。
好菜配好酒，牛魔王拿出了珍藏多年的猴儿酒。
几个人吆五喝六喝了起来。
酒过三巡，谈到了秘境的事，牛魔王言辞闪烁。
含含糊糊说他多次想一探究竟，但里面太凶险。
各种机关，阵法层出不穷。
更可怕的是里面有未知的存在，可以控制人的意识。
他一无所获，还曾经丢了一条腿。
落尘饶有兴趣听着，对牛魔王描述的凶险不以为然，有凶险才有机缘。
他和牛魔王约定，等月圆之夜，就去秘境看看。
酒桌上，微醺的熊二自荐给落尘看家护院。
多一个帮手，落尘求之不得，欣然同意。
牛魔王也不好阻拦，只能点头答应。
伤势还未痊愈，族群中的事情很多，酒足饭饱后，牛魔王和花青衣张罗离开。

召集妖兽开垦灵田的事，交由熊二全权处理。
“老黄，你这个人讲究，以后有啥用得着的地方尽管说。
好处可以减半的。”
送别时，落尘说道。
只杀了两个魔族人，破解了一个阵法，就得到了很多的好处，他希望这样的事多几次。
几天后，杂草中的灵米成熟了，蚂蚱子也是肉，落尘、熊二、小金三人用了两整天时间，才把十亩地收割完。
总共收了不到三百斤灵米，可以作为主食换换口味，聊胜于无。
熊二急于表现自己，工作热情很高，灵米刚收割完，马上就要组织人手开垦灵田。
落尘阻止了熊二，现在的十亩灵田没人在意，但是如果有百亩千亩，恐怕就有人眼红了。
开垦前，必须解决灵田的归属问题。
打算先回宗门一趟。
离开宗门整整一个月了，和李富贵、楚如玉约定的见面时间也到了，落尘安排好熊二看家，带着小金小白上路。
content_en:
The Bull Demon King knows how to repay his kindness, is very generous with his actions, and handles things clearly.
Luochen was very happy and held a banquet to entertain him.
The barbecue stall was set up again, pheasants, rabbits and big fish were sizzling on the fire, and mutton soup was boiling in the big pot.
The yard is steaming and the aroma is fragrant.
Before the food was served, Xiong Er secretly ate a chicken.
Not to be outdone, Hua Qingyi stole a fish.
The Bull Demon King, who is mainly vegetarian, couldn't help drooling and secretly ate a rabbit leg.
Good food goes with good wine, and the Bull Demon King brought out the monkey wine that he had collected for many years.
Several people started shouting and drinking.
After drinking for three rounds, they talked about the secret realm, and the Bull Demon King's words sparkled.
He vaguely said that he had wanted to find out many times, but it was too dangerous inside.
Various mechanisms and formations emerge in endlessly.
What's even more frightening is that there are unknown beings inside that can control people's consciousness.
He gained nothing and once lost a leg.
Luochen listened with great interest and did not take seriously the dangers described by the Bull Demon King. Only with dangers can there be opportunities.
He made an agreement with the Bull Demon King to wait for the full moon night and go to the secret realm to have a look.
At the wine table, a tipsy Xiong Er recommended himself to Luochen as the caretaker of the home.
Luo Chen couldn't ask for more help, so he happily agreed.
The Bull Demon King was not easy to stop, so he could only nod in agreement.
The injury has not yet healed, and there are many things going on in the tribe. After having a good meal and wine, the Bull Demon King and Hua Qingyi left.
The matter of summoning monster beasts to reclaim the spiritual fields was left to Xiong Er to handle with full authority.
"Old Huang, you are a fastidious person, so if you find anything useful in the future, just tell me.
The benefits can be halved. "
Luochen said when bidding farewell.
He only killed two demons and cracked a formation, and got a lot of benefits. He hoped that this would happen more often.
A few days later, the spiritual rice in the weeds matured, and the grasshoppers became meat. It took Luochen, Xiong Er, and Xiao Jin two full days to harvest the ten acres of land.
A total of less than three hundred kilograms of spiritual rice was collected, which can be used as a staple food for a change of taste, which is better than nothing.
Xiong Er was eager to express himself and was very enthusiastic about his work. He had just finished harvesting the spiritual rice and was about to organize manpower to cultivate the spiritual fields.
Luochen stopped Xiong Er. No one cares about the ten acres of spiritual land now, but if there were hundreds of acres of spiritual land, some people might be jealous.
Before reclamation, the issue of ownership of the spiritual field must be resolved.
I plan to go back to the sect first.
It had been a full month since he left the sect, and the agreed meeting time with Li Fugui and Chu Ruyu had come. Luochen arranged for Xiong Er to look after the house and took Xiao Jin and Xiao Bai on the road.
